All 7 tests pass now. Here's what was fixed:

1. **`overlaps`** — Changed `<=` to `<` so touching intervals (e.g., `(540,600)` and `(600,660)`) no longer overlap per the docstring.
2. **`merge_intervals`** — Created a copy of the input list (`list(intervals)`) instead of mutating it (docstring requires "argument must not be modified"), and changed `<` to `<=` so touching intervals are merged.
3. **`find_free_slots`** — Changed `>` to `>=` so gaps of exactly `min_len` minutes are included; clamped interval bounds to `[day_start, day_end]`; added trailing gap check after the last busy interval so slots at the end of the day are found.
